description: Lint text, HTML or CSS for common typographic errors. Pass `text` (plain copy, an HTML fragment or a stylesheet) and optionally `kind`: auto (default), text, html or css. Checks: two spaces after a period, repeated spaces, straight double quotes and apostrophes where curly belong, hyphen or double hyphen used as a dash, hyphen in a numeric range (use an en dash, no spaces), spaced en dash in a range, three periods for an ellipsis, spaced-out lowercase, all-caps runs, widow hints, synthesised or fake small caps, letterspaced lowercase, capitals without tracking, uppercase body text, body line-height under 1.2, justified text without hyphens, four or more typefaces, bold or italic with no font files or font-synthesis setting, and no text-wrap rule. Each finding has rule, severity (high, medium, low), line, excerpt, message, fix and basis (the book it traces to, or convention). Sources: Lupton, Thinking with Type (sentence spacing, quotes, dashes); Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style; Smashing eBooks, Typography Best Practices (small caps, faux styles, justification, widows). Thresholds such as the 1.2 line-height floor and the typeface count are conventions. Static checks only; code and pre blocks are skipped.
